brand.anonBody: Your answers are never linked back to your account. Not by ID, not by email — by nothing at all.

home.body: Four artists. One island. We're asking you what the night should look like — who plays, what it costs, which date.
home.note: Takes about two minutes. Your answers are stored with no link back to you — your account only stops the same person voting twice.

signup.title: Get set up
signup.intro: Email and phone are both needed — it's how we keep one person to one vote. Neither is ever attached to your answers.

login.title: Welcome back
login.intro: Pick up where you left off.

q1.question: Which one's you?
q1.helper: This decides which questions we ask later, so pick the closest fit.

q2.question: How keen are you on a night like this?
q2.helper: 1 is 'not my thing', 10 is 'tell me where to be'.

voted.title: You're already in
voted.body: This account has submitted its answers. One account, one vote — that's how we keep the results honest.

expired.title: Session timed out
expired.body: Log back in and your answers will pick up from the top.

preview.title: That's the preview
preview.body: Fourteen more questions are on the way. So far: {audience}, keenness {interest}/10 — nothing has been sent to the server yet.

errors.duplicate: That email or phone is already registered.
errors.invalid_credentials: Those details don't match. Try again.
errors.rate_limit: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and retry.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
